in_sanskrit.name: Jaishankar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victory of Shankara
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jaishankar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Jaishankar is derived from Sanskrit words 'Jai' meaning victory and 'Shankara' meaning Lord Shiva. This name is a tribute to the supreme power and strength of Lord Shiva, symbolizing the victorious spirit of the one who bears this name.

in_marathi.name: Jaishankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of Shankara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaishankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jaishankar is derived from Sanskrit words 'Jai' meaning victory and 'Shankara' meaning Lord Shiva. This name is a tribute to the supreme power and strength of Lord Shiva, symbolizing the victorious spirit of the one who bears this name.
